text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. A balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and water gives you energy and helps you stay fit. Regular exercise, like walking or swimming, keeps your heart strong and reduces stress. Getting enough sleep is also important, because it helps your body and brain recover. Mental health matters just as much as physical health, so make time to relax and talk to friends. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. Don't spend all your time working or studying. Enjoy your free time, and remember that small daily habits can make a big difference to your health.
